steps.content: The sword's razor edge slices through the curtain, its tearing sound jarringly halting all movement.
The "performers" whirl around, curious to catch a glimpse of the newcomer invading their realm.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Wake up! Break free from the script!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't get trapped in the act forever.
The people around didn't keep moving; they're like clockwork toys with stuck gears, subtly stuck in a loop of the same motion.
They line up on both sides, creating an unseen path just for you.
With your silver sword in tow, you advance.
Never before has the stage seemed so endless; you stride on, relentlessly seeking the presence of Ignis and Luvia Ray.
It's not until you arrive under the hovering dancer that you finally spot those two dear companions.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Ignis, Luvia, so glad you're safe.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Let's bring this to a close, and draw the curtain on this drama.
You step forward to them, extending your hand to take them with you.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: The curtain falls...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Yet our lives, they've barely started...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Are those your lines?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Or...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: In this place, my acting is as seamless as life itself.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: My spoken words are my own script.
Luvia Ray steps closer, looking at you intently, unlike her usual demeanor.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Ray? Wait, that's not it... You...
Sophisticated, dignified, with head held high, reminiscent of a proud swan on the stage.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Not that deep, but indeed closer to the source than the usual Black Ring. That's why there are stricter defense rules here, including controlling our impulsive behaviors. All to prevent Mania from the other side from seeping in.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I dream of being a triumphant actress!
Luvia Ray grasps your hand, spinning you around once.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: And then... and then...
A faint change crosses Luvia Ray's face, and she stops speaking.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I understand that in the script, anything the author wishes can come to life.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But, all of this is...

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: What exactly is all this?
The spotlight flickers off, shifting its focus.
White light bathes her red hair, its glare nearly dazzling.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I... yearn for a different life... to have an...

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: An authentic, everyday life of an ordinary person.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I can stroll down the streets freely, without attracting curious stares; awakening to the morning sun, working butter into dough, gazing as the bread gently swells in the oven...

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: All will be calm and in order, nothing will go awry, nothing will be ruined.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I'll manage to make the perfect apple pie, to let him try... he...
steps.female_content: I'll manage to make the perfect apple pie, to let her try... she...

steps.content: Ignis's voice fades into silence, motionless.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I understand your longing for an everyday life, to be just like any other girl, preparing dishes by hand, living normally...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But the person you hope to savor these dishes with... do they exist in this life, in this story?
You attempt to pull your hand back, but Ignis holds on firmly, lifting it to her chest in a gesture akin to a prayer.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Right... Our story's just one role short... If you stay, it'll all fall into place.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: The story could come alive, turn into a play, become reality.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Your talents make you a natural star, you can decide your own script!
Before you've had the chance to process it, Luvia Ray, quiet for so long at your side, takes your other hand in the same way Ignis did.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Step into the spotlight, be the star of the show, the brightest of all!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Take the lead, be our guide and guardian!
You escape their hold, and yet immediately feel a stinging pain in your wrist.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: This is what I desire... ${PlayerName}. To be no burden to my loved ones, to cause them no pain... To live each day without the dread of being overwhelmed by fear.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I don't need to fear being out of control and no one will ever control me...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Come, you've already discovered the character you're meant to be, right? Or else you wouldn't have taken up the sword, would you?

Ignis and Luvia Ray close in slowly, with the spotlight intensifying on them. The blazing light clearly reveals the swirling dust. Narrowing your eyes for a better look, you quickly grasp the situation.
Numerous fine strings, attached to the performers' joints on stage, puppeteer their every move and word.
Beyond them, in the shadowy realm above the stage, a massive dress shrouds all.

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: Act... Dance...
As she spins, the delicate strings move with her, leading all the performers in a uniform dance around you.

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: Face the desires in your heart, and set them free...

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Face the desires in your heart, and set them free...

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: Choose the life you yearn for, and pen it into the script...

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Choose the life you yearn for, and pen it into the script...

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: I will... The script will... make all your wishes come true...
Once more, everyone begins to move, twirling around you incessantly, as they did before.
With each step, you're driven inexorably to the brink of the stage. However, there's a twist—in your grip lies the silver sword Lady Pearl had just entrusted to you.
Looking over your shoulder, you spot Lady Pearl sitting in her seat, watching the stage's spectacle with a serene detachment.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Let us see... what you would choose.
